title: leptoskit.workspace.toml
description: Applications with separate configuration, artifacts, and release state.

applications.description: Stable deployment identities, independent of Cargo package names.

format_version.description: Must be [`WORKSPACE_VERSION`]. Omission never silently selects a format.

Application.description: One app directory containing its own `leptoskit.toml`.

bindings.description: Calls this app can make. These do not imply startup ordering or trust.

depends-on.description: Applications that must become ready before this application starts.

path.description: Directory relative to the workspace manifest. Paths cannot escape it.

Binding.description: A private endpoint and credential reference owned by one caller.

token-env.description:
Caller environment variable that will hold the credential for this
binding. This names a variable; it never contains a credential.

url-env.description: Caller environment variable that will hold the private base URL.
